title: #368 Nature or Nurture
prompt: Scientists have been debating the impact of nature and nurture on people’s personality and behavior. Nature brings you inborn skills and nurture helps you obtain skills by practices. Which one do you think has a greater influence?

modelPlan.focus: Analyze the relative influence of nature and nurture on personality and behavior, focusing on inborn traits versus learned skills through practice.
outline: Introduction: Present the debate between nature and nurture, defining both concepts.
Body 1: Discuss the role of nature, including genetics and innate skills.
Body 2: Explore the role of nurture, such as environment, education, and socialization.
Conclusion: Compare the influences and argue which has a greater impact.
keyArguments: Nature provides foundational traits that influence personality and behavior.
Nurture shapes these traits through environmental factors and learning experiences.

plan.focus: Analyze the relative influence of nature and nurture on personality and behavior, focusing on inborn traits versus learned skills through practice.
outline: Introduction: Present the debate between nature and nurture, defining both concepts.
Body 1: Discuss the role of nature, including genetics and innate skills.
Body 2: Explore the role of nurture, such as environment, education, and socialization.
Conclusion: Compare the influences and argue which has a greater impact.
keyArguments: Nature provides foundational traits that influence personality and behavior.
Nurture shapes these traits through environmental factors and learning experiences.
